emojis.label: stampede at indian festival
emojis.title: 17 Dead, Dozens Injured After Stampede at Indian Religious Event
emojis.summary: Such deadly crowd events are relatively common in India, and it was unclear what caused this one. Authorities detained the event’s organizer and others involved.

emojis.title: Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinians and European Officials in West Bank
emojis.summary: Extremists assaulted residents and broke a European diplomatic vehicle’s window, witnesses said, as settler violence surges in the territory during the olive harvest.

emojis.summary: The men were charged in the murders of two Australians and an American who were on a camping and surf vacation in Mexico.
